questions.prompt: g(x) = x² - 10x + 30. Complete the square to write g in vertex form, then give the minimum value of g and where it happens.

g(x) = x² - 10x + 30.

questions.prompt: A ball's height is h(t) = -t² + 8t + 2 meters after t seconds. Complete the square (write h in vertex form) to find the greatest height and when it happens.

A ball's height is h(t) = -t² + 8t + 2 meters after t seconds.
